structure_proposals.why: Face pulls run on four of your six days, which is 12 weekly sets of a corrective — more than any lift you actually want to grow — and it puts them on back-to-back days twice per rotation, which is exactly what you objected to. Dropping them from Push A and Push B leaves them on Pull A and Pull B, three slots apart, and Push B already trains rear delts with the reverse pec deck.

You added Bulgarian split squats yourself on Legs A even though they are in no session in the plan, so right now the one unilateral leg exercise you actually chose has no home and no progression history. Legs B is the shorter leg day and has no single-leg work at all, so that is where I would give it a permanent slot.

The plank is a timed hold, so nothing can progress it and you delivered 45 seconds against a 60-second target — it is the one slot on Legs B that cannot get harder over the meso. Swapping it for hanging leg raises gives Legs B the same direct ab work Legs A already gets and a rep count that can actually climb.
